crossRefs.note: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John’s…
“Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?
Who is wise, that he may understand these things? Who is prudent, that he may know them? For the ways of Yahweh are…
The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a drunkard, a friend of tax…
Now the natural man doesn’t receive the things of God’s Spirit, for they are foolishness to him, and he can’t know…
But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is judged by no one.
